craft_notes: Sthāyin: soon-joy (aloneness near). Sanskrit first: dual subject + qualification + optative → L4 sets ground line 1, fruit line 2. Rows: row 1 (sight-last — susphuṭa/dawns close). Rupture: colon after bright — ground held, fruit promised. Close: end-weight on dawning. Minimal pass: colon for L3 comma. Read aloud: firm, bright, soon. Rejected: 'solitude' for kevalatā — killed: aloneness kept (kevala-register); 'vortex' for vṛtti — killed: whirlings plain (turnings sung).

lines: Self-knowledge and deep rest, firm-set and bright:
whirlings shed, aloneness dawns in sight.
l4.sanskrit_cite: svaparijñaptiviśrāntī sudṛḍhe yasya susphuṭe / tasya vṛttivimuktasya bhavet kevalatācirāt
